attribution: "Violated 3-31-13a (8618837455).jpg" by inkknife_2000 (7.5 million views +), CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: pair=h02309; source platform: commons; file is the source rendition at https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ac/Violated_3-31-13a_%288618837455%29.jpg/500px-Violated_3-31-13a_%288618837455%29.jpg; labels are drafts, not reviewed

problem_locations.region: house front with smashed window panes and a broken door

draft_facts: broken window glass on a trashed home (caption)
source_caption: (1 in a mutliple picture set) I think of my Flickr pages as a place for beauty, so it is hard to include this picture. But it is, sadly, a sign of our times. We have a place called Panorama Point in our town of Redlands, CA. When a developer bought the land there, he agreed to fence off the point and put in a road to it, lined with a nice white fence. I've noticed in the last months that those who go up there at night (young people with too much to drink, perhaps) have begun to destroy the fence. This Sunday I found they had now started to vandalize one of the lovely, big homes that have sat empty since our recession. It is so sad! America should not have this element in it. (See next picture.)
author: inkknife_2000 (7.5 million views +)
